name: OpenPanel
summary: Open-source web and product analytics platform — funnels, retention, session replay, revenue — with optional self-hosting.
description: An open-source Mixpanel alternative: event tracking, funnels, cohorts, retention, session replay, A/B breakdowns and revenue tracking on real-time dashboards. Cookieless and GDPR-focused, with SDKs for web, React, Vue, mobile and server, a REST API and 38 MCP tools for Claude, Cursor and other agents. Cloud plans from $2.50/mo; self-hosted under AGPL-3.0.
contains: funnels, retention cohorts, user profiles, session replay, A/B variant breakdowns
38 MCP tools for Claude, Cursor and other MCP clients
SDKs: JavaScript, React, Next.js, Vue, React Native, Swift, Kotlin, Python
REST API (track, export, insights) and integrations incl. Google Search Console and Slack
self-hosting with Docker Compose, Coolify, Dokploy or Kubernetes
cloud pricing by events: 5K/mo $2.50 up to 50M/mo; 30-day free trial
cookieless tracking, EU hosted, GDPR compliant
free 2.5M events/mo for open-source projects; 7.1k GitHub stars
